subject: Sub-account reference for Brightline receipts
text:
Hello,

To be clear up front, this is NOT a bank change. We remain with JPMorgan Chase, same routing number 021000021, and our legal name and tax ID are as you have them.

As part of a ledger reorganization, receipts from customers in your region are being booked to sub-account 000044449123. Please key that in place of the number ending 5555 for anything you pay after this week. Nothing else about how you pay us is different.

Regards,
Brightline Accounting
